correctness.rationale: The subset-of-divisors recurrence follows by disjoint include/exclude cases and remains exact when sums>N are masked. Independently reimplemented at-most-j integer bitsets, a different recurrence initialization from source exact-j layers; checked every integer 0..n! for n=1..12, all 792 divisors of 12!, and first/largest unrepresented numbers. Independent recomputation produced h=(1,1,2,3,4,5,5,6,7,7,7,8), with exactly 175 misses at seven terms, first 475785157 and last 479001547; all 479001601 totals represented by at most eight distinct divisors. The source artifact lists 175 integers and the displayed eight-term witness sums to the first. This is an exhaustive finite result, NOT an inference about later factorials.
residual_risks: Finite 12! enumeration uses ~480 million bit positions; exact Python big integers and deterministic update order, not probabilistic testing. Complete recursive Git tree could not be inventoried via available connector.
